answer: A cloned badge cannot close a karst survey slot by itself. Applicant locks 16.4 POA and draws permit KS-583 at shaft B-7. Within 36 minutes they must walk a 91 m thread of tagged stations and leave a raven clip on the last bolt, then post a 0.31 kg core chip plus two time-stamped photos. The desk rejects any second clip on the same bolt, any walk under 9 minutes, and any photo set that lacks the shaft clock. If the clip id mismatches the permit, the 16.4 POA bond is burned and the shaft stays closed.
